metadata.sub_category: Electronic equipments : cardiofrequence mesure, stop watch, compass, disposable cameras ( with or without flash), fitness console, pedometer, altimeter, watches, and other equipments containing electronic parts

identity.definition: Consumer electronic equipment including measuring functions (heart rate monitors, sports watches, pedometers) with or without radio transmission modules (Bluetooth, WiFi).

documents.Description: States compliance with RED, RoHS, etc. Must be translated into the language of the Member State.
